Description: A 64.5-cycle, 1736-amp, line-to-line-to-ground (ABG) fault tripped the substation circuit breaker, which stayed open 2.2 seconds and then reclosed successfully. The first three cycles of the fault period were a single-line-to-ground fault on B. The remainder of the 64.5-cycle fault period was ABG.
